subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Software-Defined Vehicle
description: A quick win: understand The Software-Defined Vehicle.

hook.text: Modern cars run on over 100 million lines of code—more than a fighter jet or a space shuttle.

buildup.text: A software-defined vehicle separates hardware from features, letting software unlock what the car can do.

discovery.text: Heated seats, faster acceleration, and self-driving features can all be turned on with a software purchase.

twist.text: Critics call this pay-to-unlock approach a way to sell you hardware you already own behind a paywall.

climax.text: The shift turns automakers into tech companies that earn revenue from subscriptions, not just car sales.

punchline.text: The car you buy may be defined more by its code than its engine.

quiz.question: What does 'software-defined vehicle' mean?
options: Software controls and unlocks car features independent of hardware
